paragraphs: Galaxy Digital sells volunteer management software under the Get Connected name, built for organizations that recruit, schedule, track and report on volunteers. The organizations described range from food banks and healthcare systems to municipal departments and corporate social impact teams.

The platform puts scheduling, hour tracking, communication and reporting in one place. Volunteers check in through an onsite kiosk or a free mobile app. Liability waivers and e-signatures are collected and stored digitally. The software is sold in tiers, with the largest aimed at organizations running multiple programs or locations under separate volunteer coordinators.

A separate edition called Center serves organizations that sit at the middle of a network of nonprofit partners. That edition adds statewide and citywide volunteerism reporting. The company states its network reaches 405 volunteer centers, more than 60,000 mission-driven organizations and millions of volunteers. It also reports acquiring HandsOn Connect.
